name: Hardened Tumor
summary: In Silverpine, the Royal Apothecary Society studies a rare growth found in Vile Fin murlocs. Apothecary Berard first recorded it before Arugal's curse left him a mindless servant.

sections.title: A Rare Biological Anomaly
sections.body: Along Lake Lordamere, Vile Fin murlocs sometimes develop a rare, calcified growth. Apothecary Berard recorded it while studying wildlife along Silverpine Forest's eastern borders. It appears only in mature specimens along the shoreline and the Dawning Isles. Its cause remains uncertain, yet the Royal Apothecary Society took notice of the dense tissue.

sections.title: Fuel for the New Plague
sections.body:
After Arugal's curse left Berard a mindless servant, his journal was recovered from Pyrewood Village and taken to Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher. Renferrel saw promise in the work and sent Forsaken agents to retrieve a Hardened Tumor and native aquatic mosses.

Master Apothecary Faranell oversees the Apothecarium in the Undercity. He seeks reagents that can resist decay or alter biological matter, and added the growth to the Society's ongoing work on the New Plague.

faq.answer: A Hardened Tumor is a rare, abnormal calcified mass that forms inside Vile Fin murlocs around Lake Lordamere. Apothecary Berard discovered it, and its unusual biological properties resist ordinary physical decay.

faq.q: Why does the Royal Apothecary Society want it?
faq.answer: The Royal Apothecary Society gathers unusual toxic and biological specimens for its work on the New Plague. Master Apothecary Faranell considers the tumor's resilience and cellular makeup a candidate for blight experiments.
Vile Fin murlocs in Silverpine Forest carry these tumors, including those near the Dawning Isles in eastern Lake Lordamere and along the village shores northeast of Ambermill.

Apothecary Berard was a Royal Apothecary Society apothecary stationed in Silverpine Forest. He researched local flora, fauna, and murloc mutations, and uncovered the utility of the Dawning Isles' mosses and hardened tumors. Arugal's curse made him a mindless servant in Pyrewood Village.

angles.text: As an Undead, you help Master Apothecary Faranell advance his research into the New Plague. You serve Lady Sylvanas and the Forsaken's struggle against living and undead adversaries.
